mapper.select: SELECT clubOwner_key AS clubOwnerKey, club_name AS clubName, club_logo AS clubLogo, club_region AS clubRegion, club_status AS clubStatus, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS clubCreated, club_content AS clubContent FROM club WHERE clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE club SET club_name = #{clubName}, club_logo = #{clubLogo}, club_region = #{clubRegion}, club_content = #{clubContent} WHERE clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey}
